$comment: Template for data/<league>/availability.json. One entry per player worth writing down. `status` is out, doubtful, questionable, probable or available, or give `probabilityOut` directly; `points` is how many points the team is worse without the player and defaults by `position` (QB 6, EDGE 1.2, WR 1.2, CB 1, OT 1, RB 1, others under 1). `weeks` lists the weeks the entry speaks to; leave it out to cover every week. `reportedAt` decides whether a market line already prices the report: an entry older than the morning pull changes nothing on a priced line and still moves every projection. Bump `updatedAt` whenever the file changes so the board and the refresh job pick it up.
